question: Which bodily forms of prostration are sanctioned for acts of worship?
premises: Prostration may be performed with eight limbs.
Prostration may alternatively be performed with five limbs.
Both forms are approved in acts of worship.
inference: Therefore, either eight-limbed or five-limbed prostration is sanctioned in worship acts.
plain_english: Then, in acts of worship, prostration performed with eight limbs or with five limbs is approved.
